skill.description: Build generative art, shaders, interactive sketches, and 3D scenes with p5.js.

memory.responsibility: Retain sketch concept plus decisions, observations, and verification evidence needed to resume safely.

planning.responsibility: Transform p5.js canvas into the ordered, bounded stages defined by this skill.

action.responsibility: Advance the workflow through drawing and shader code while preserving stop conditions and user authority.

capability.responsibility: Expose only the production and rendering capabilities needed for the requested artifact and format.

stages: Define canvas size motion and interaction
Build the drawing loop and scene state
Add geometry particles shader or 3D forms
Capture a deterministic seed and preview

maturity.claim_boundary: This repository validates and plans the harness contract; it does not claim live service execution or benchmark gains without a connected adapter and measured evidence.
